_about: Default plan configuration for the logistics planner. The admin planner edits a live copy of this (saved to the Logistics sheet through the bridge, or carried in a share link); this file is the fallback and the starting point.

party.label: Balinese artist group

vehicles.name: Car (4 seats)
vehicles._why: For days when only a few travel (talks): a car goes instead of a Tempo Traveller.

party.notes: 25 artists + 2 volunteers travel together in two tempo travellers; on days when only a few go (a talk), one car. Instruments and sets go in a separate vehicle (not counted in artist time).

stays.name: Jana Seva Vidya Kendra
stays.address: Jana Seva Trust campus, 20th Mile, Bengaluru–Magadi Road, Channenahalli 562130

stays.name: Citadel Sarovar Portico
stays.address: 41 Ananda Rao Circle, Gandhi Nagar, Bengaluru 560009 (near KSR railway station)

day._outstation: Out-of-town venues (Manipal): travel overnight both ways, leaving after outstationDepart; freshenUp minutes on arrival.
day._vehicles: Instruments and sets travel in a separate vehicle arranged by production; loadOut/loadIn cover the group's personal kit only.
day._rhythm: Instruments travel separately, so mornings are: wake → breakfast (typically 7.30–8.30, 30–45 min) → get ready 30 → personal kit into the vehicle 10 → go. On a late-start day the group still wakes at restDayWake and eats at 7.30.

buffers._about: Minutes before a show: setup (instruments, stage), soundcheck, ready (costume, make-up, warm-up, call). After: change (costume off, make-up removal) then after (wrap: pack, meet people, load-out). Per-event overrides live in overrides[event id].

Talk._why: A talk: speaker plus a demonstrator at most; nothing to bring (set-up 0 = no instrument vehicle), no costume or make-up.

traffic._about: Multiplier over free-flow drive time by hour of departure, Bengaluru. Weekend column is lighter. Replaced by live Google traffic when the bridge provider is on.

_extras: Internal engagements not on the public calendar (photoshoots, rehearsals, receptions). Same shape as the planner's form; merged into the schedule.

travel._about: The company's flights. The arrival day runs airport → stay; the departure day ends with the run to the airport, checkInLead minutes before the flight. A flight before 06:00 is planned on the evening before.

joiners._about: People who join the company on a day. travel:true = they ride with the group (counted for vehicles); false = they perform alongside but come on their own.
